svg.text: Every 25 m a landing slides by, in reach ~6 s:
squads fire across, some jump on
Jet troopers drop onto the platform
Debris: shadow grows on the deck for 1.5 s
Two power cuts: fight onto the level landing,
breaker (hold 4 s) while a wave arrives; back
aboard within 5 s of the restart
Breakout under the top decks' sky: transport door
~100 s of travel + two stops. Falling off or dying:
re-form on the platform. Solo: fewer jumpers.
